grammar_exhaustion.reason: the product exhausted all shared character frontiers before both complete semantic paths reached a 39--60-letter terminal pair

next_discriminator.operator: held-out initial-setting+SVO frame selected for the OBJECT/SUBJECT dead frontier
next_discriminator.selection_rule: introduce setting-preposition/object roles before the subject; no selected tape is edited after the orbit product
next_discriminator.falsifier: if the setting frame produces no new shared frontier at the first exhausted orbit, reject the frame and keep the prior grammar closed

reader_gate: closed; no exact candidate is human readability evidence until blinded readers compare intact and shuffled controls
